products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a non-profit government research lab founded in 2020. Its site describes it as a global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its work centers on the Falcon family of generative large language models, which it presents as making advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

The Falcon line includes Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E, Falcon Perception, a multimodal model that reads and interprets images from natural language prompts, Falcon Arabic, built for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic and instruction-following, Falcon Mamba 7B, which the site calls the first open source released State Space Language Model, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, Falcon 40B with 40 billion parameters trained on one trillion tokens, and Falcon 10B. The company says Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B, as verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. Falcon models are described as open-source, multilingual and multimodal, with Falcon 180B and Falcon 40B released with weights for research and commercial use.

TII launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models and sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects. AI71, described as an AI company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, issued a global Call for Proposals for developers to build use cases with Falcon 10B, with the best proposals awarded compute access. TII also runs the Falcon LLM Hackfest: Wings of Innovation Challenge and an initiative inviting university researchers and AI practitioners to submit proposals for using Falcon. The Falcon model is tracked as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0 licensing, positioned around sovereign AI and Middle East data residency. No litigation is recorded against the company.
